title: growth-sprint step result
description: <sprint>/results/<step id>.json, written by whoever ran the step (subagent or the orchestrator's own session) as its last act. It can only send a step to a person (pending items) or record what was spent: a step is never done because this file says so, only when scripts/check_step.py finds its outputs on disk. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py agents/growth-sprint/assets/step-result.schema.json <file>

status.description: Same meaning as the run line status of the agent.

spent_eur.description: Cash actually spent by the step (provider invoices or the agent's own estimate output), 0 when local.

pending.description: Every decision that waits for a person: a spend gate reached, a publication to approve, an input nobody could supply.

defaults_used.description: Decisions taken without the founder (autonomous mode), for the sprint report.
